title: [Main] - Bug 659462: [Expense Agent]  Add configurable rounding precision for partial-day per diem
summary: The Expense Agent now supports configurable rounding precision for partial-day per diem calculations, allowing administrators to set how fractional daily amounts are rounded.
key_points: New rounding precision setting added to the Expense Agent Setup table and page
The partial-day per diem settings page exposes the rounding setting
The per diem calculation applies the configured rounding to partial-day amounts
Small related change in the Expense Agent Setup Wizard
Tests added for the rounding behavior
